commit.message:
feat(browser): remote live-check observability — toolbelt/work-graph/river planes ride the state whitelist

The post-edge-deploy live check (POSTGRES_NOTIFY wake + agent toolbelt flow)
needs remote evidence in the supervisor state table:

- buildDevosRuntimeObservability now carries bounded agent_toolbelt counters
  (state, lease/issued/pending/served counts, requests parsed/issued/
  unavailable, terminal results, issue errors, route-unavailable streak) and
  the work_graph summary (roadmap objective/milestone/plan state, tasks,
  claims) from the devos task cycle snapshot — inside supervisor_lifecycle,
  which is ALREADY on the edge state whitelist. Bounded counters only; no
  payloads, no authority.
- Edge boundedState whitelist gains rsi / rsi_outcome_river /
  rsi_operator_steering as boundedObject(16384) planes — same pattern as the
  adjacent whitelist entries, rides the same operator edge deploy that
  unlocks POSTGRES_NOTIFY and /v1/commands/issue-tool.

After the deploy the state table shows: control_latency.fast_lane wake
reason (POSTGRES_NOTIFY), supervisor_lifecycle.devos_runtime.agent_toolbelt
(issue flow), .work_graph (objective -> tasks -> claims) and the rsi river
snapshot (anchors/cases/credits) — the full live-check surface in one query.

Tests: +1 (20 in devos-work-graph.test.mjs — projection composition,
degradation, edge whitelist pins). Full suite: 3280 pass / 0 fail / 2
skipped. npm run check green.
